title: Build and test from the CLI
user_visible_behavior: Empty app target and test target build and run tests from the CLI.
verification: Clone the repository into an empty directory and run `./init.sh` there.
It exits 0.

title: Create a game
user_visible_behavior: User creates a game with a name; names are trimmed, non-empty and unique case- and diacritic-insensitively.
verification: Test: a blank name is rejected.
Test: "Taifa" vs " taifa " is rejected as a duplicate.

title: List games alphabetically
user_visible_behavior: Library lists games alphabetically, with an empty state when there are none.
verification: Test on the library query: alphabetical order.
Test on the library query: empty flag when there are no games.

title: Rename or delete a game
user_visible_behavior: User renames or deletes a game; deleting removes its rulebook, passages and stored file.
verification: Test: after delete, passage count and stored-file count for that rulebook ID are 0.

title: Rulebook ID from file bytes
user_visible_behavior: A rulebook ID is the SHA-256 of the file bytes.
verification: Test: same bytes give the same ID.
Test: one changed byte gives a different ID.

title: Extract ordered passages
user_visible_behavior: Extraction turns a text-layer PDF into ordered passages, each with a valid locator.
verification: Build a synthetic PDF in the test with PDFKit.
Test: expected texts, order and page indices.
Test: every rect is inside its page bounds.
notes: Task: T3. Single-column only; multi-column is deferred to ADR-002.

title: Join hyphenation and normalise whitespace
user_visible_behavior: Extraction joins line-break hyphenation and normalises whitespace.
verification: Test: a synthetic "cons-⏎truir" yields passage text containing "construir".

title: Import a rulebook atomically
user_visible_behavior: Importing into a game without a rulebook stores the file copy, the rulebook and its passages atomically.
verification: Test: after import, passage count equals extraction output and the stored file exists.
Test: the Taifa fixture imports with 16 pages.
notes: Task: T3. Taifa 3.0 lives only in the test target, with its attribution file.

title: Reject PDFs without a text layer
user_visible_behavior: Import of a PDF with no text layer fails with an explicit error and persists nothing.
verification: Test with an image-only synthetic PDF: error `.noTextLayer`.
Test: zero rulebooks and passages persisted.

title: Reject locked or unreadable files
user_visible_behavior: Import of a locked or unreadable file fails with an explicit error and persists nothing.
verification: Test with an encrypted file and a corrupt file: distinct errors.
Test: nothing persisted in either case.

title: Re-import of the same file
user_visible_behavior: Re-importing the same file into the same game is a no-op; the same file into another game is refused, naming that game.
verification: Test: locators before and after re-import are equal and counts unchanged.
Test: a second game gets `.alreadyImported(gameName)`.

title: Delete a game's rulebook
user_visible_behavior: User deletes a game's rulebook; the game stays and can import again.
verification: Test: the game remains.
Test: rulebook, passages and stored file are gone.
Test: import is offered again.

title: Text search in a rulebook
user_visible_behavior: Text search returns passages of the game's rulebook containing all query terms, case- and diacritic-insensitively, ranked by term frequency then reading order.
verification: Test on a synthetic rulebook: AND semantics.
Test: "construccion" matches "construcción".
Test: ranking is stable.

title: Explicit no-match state
user_visible_behavior: A query with zero matches shows the no-match state, never approximate matches.
verification: Test: search state is `.noMatch` with an empty list for an absent term.

title: Open a match highlighted on its page
user_visible_behavior: Opening a match shows its page in the page viewer with the passage rectangle highlighted.
verification: Test: the page index and highlight bounds passed to the viewer equal the locator's.
notes: Task: T4. The PDFKit viewer is the pending UIKit exception and needs its own ADR.

title: Baseline search evaluation
user_visible_behavior: Baseline run: the eval set (Codable JSON) is evaluated against search over the Taifa fixture and a report with hit@1, hit@3 and no-match accuracy is written, tagged with OS version.
verification: `./init.sh` produces the report file.
Test: fails if the eval set is malformed.
Test: fails if the fixture is missing.
notes: Task: after m4 (module 5, next to the AI it is compared against).
